mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pm_task WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY due_date ASC, priority DESC, id DESC
SELECT t.*, m.name AS assignee_name FROM pm_task t LEFT JOIN pm_member m ON t.assignee_id = m.id WHERE t.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY t.due_date ASC, t.priority DESC, t.id DESC
SELECT t.*, m.name AS assignee_name FROM pm_task t LEFT JOIN pm_member m ON t.assignee_id = m.id WHERE t.id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM pm_task WHERE assignee_id = #{assigneeId} ORDER BY due_date ASC
SELECT * FROM pm_task WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND status = 'blocked'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pm_task (project_id, title, description, assignee_id, status, priority, estimated_hours, actual_hours, start_date, due_date, progress, tags) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{assigneeId}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{estimatedHours}, #{actualHours}, #{startDate}, #{dueDate}, #{progress}, #{tags})
